input.raw_vernacular_audio_or_text: Padosi khet ki purani medh kaat kar do feet humre khet ki or bada liya hai gehu buaai ke samay. Bolte hain ki zameen unki hai.

expected_transcription.original_text: Padosi khet ki purani medh kaat kar do feet humre khet ki or bada liya hai gehu buaai ke samay. Bolte hain ki zameen unki hai.
expected_transcription.english_text: The neighboring landowner cut down the old boundary ridge and encroached two feet into my field during wheat sowing, claiming the land belongs to them.

expected_statutory_matches.section: Section 24: Settlement of boundary disputes and demarcation
expected_statutory_matches.text_snippet: The Sub-Divisional Officer may demarcate boundaries of any holding or plot and settle any dispute concerning the same through on-spot measurement by the Lekhpal based on village Shajra map.

expected_statutory_matches.section: Section 20: Maintenance and Repair of Boundary Marks
expected_statutory_matches.text_snippet: Every tenure-holder shall be responsible for the maintenance and repair of the permanent boundary marks erected on his holding.

expected_draft_output.grievance_summary: Dispute between adjacent agricultural tenure-holders regarding an alleged two-foot encroachment resulting from cutting the boundary ridge (medh) prior to wheat sowing in Mauza Shivpur.

applicable_sections.section: Section 24: Settlement of boundary disputes and demarcation
applicable_sections.text_snippet: Authorizes demarcation based on village cadastre Shajra map and chain measurement by the Lekhpal with summary restoration of encroached ridges.

expected_draft_output.settlement_draft:
1. Both parties mutually agree to request a spot demarcation by the local Village Lekhpal within 7 days based on the official village Shajra cadastre map.
2. Both landholders agree to jointly reconstruct the boundary ridge (medh) along the demarcated coordinates, sharing the labor or cost equally.
3. Both parties undertake not to interfere with standing wheat crops or irrigation channels and agree to abide peacefully by the Lekhpal's verified boundary markers.
